paragraphs.en: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic 官方管理的高质量 Claude Code 插件目录。

paragraphs.en: A curated directory of high-quality plugins for Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: 一个精心整理的 Claude Code 高质量插件目录。

paragraphs.en: ⚠️ Important: Make sure you trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it. Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files, or other software are included in plugins and cannot verify that they will work as intended or that they won't change. See each plugin's homepage for more information.
paragraphs.zh: ⚠️ 重要提示：在安装、更新或使用插件之前，请确保你信任该插件。 Anthropic 无法控制插件中包含哪些 MCP 服务器、文件或其他软件，也无法验证它们是否会按预期工作或不会发生变更。 详情请参阅各插件的首页。

sents.en: ⚠️ Important: Make sure you trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it.
sents.zh: ⚠️ 重要提示：在安装、更新或使用插件之前，请确保你信任该插件。

sents.en: Anthropic does not control what MCP servers, files, or other software are included in plugins and cannot verify that they will work as intended or that they won't change.
sents.zh: Anthropic 无法控制插件中包含哪些 MCP 服务器、文件或其他软件，也无法验证它们是否会按预期工作或不会发生变更。

sents.en: See each plugin's homepage for more information.
sents.zh: 详情请参阅各插件的首页。

paragraphs.en: Plugins can be installed directly from this marketplace via Claude Code's plugin system.
paragraphs.zh: 插件可以直接通过 Claude Code 的插件系统从此市场安装。

paragraphs.en: or browse for the plugin in /plugin > Discover
paragraphs.zh: 或到 /plugin > Discover 中浏览该插件

paragraphs.en: Internal plugins are developed by Anthropic team members. See /plugins/example-plugin for a reference implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 内部插件由 Anthropic 团队成员开发。 参见 /plugins/example-plugin 以获取参考实现。

sents.en: Internal plugins are developed by Anthropic team members.
sents.zh: 内部插件由 Anthropic 团队成员开发。
参见 /plugins/example-plugin 以获取参考实现。

paragraphs.en: Third-party partners can submit plugins for inclusion in the marketplace. External plugins must meet quality and security standards for approval. To submit a new plugin, use the plugin directory submission form .
paragraphs.zh: 第三方合作伙伴可以提交插件以纳入市场。 外部插件必须达到质量和安全标准才能获得批准。 若要提交新插件，请使用插件目录提交表单 。

sents.en: Third-party partners can submit plugins for inclusion in the marketplace.
sents.zh: 第三方合作伙伴可以提交插件以纳入市场。

sents.en: External plugins must meet quality and security standards for approval.
sents.zh: 外部插件必须达到质量和安全标准才能获得批准。

sents.en: To submit a new plugin, use the plugin directory submission form .
sents.zh: 若要提交新插件，请使用插件目录提交表单 。

paragraphs.en: Each plugin follows a standard structure:
paragraphs.zh: 每个插件都遵循标准结构：

paragraphs.en: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # Plugin metadata (required) ├── .mcp.json # MCP server configuration (optional) ├── commands/ # Slash commands (optional) ├── agents/ # Agent definitions (optional) ├── skills/ # Skill definitions (optional) └── README.md # Documentation Plugin names are immutable The name field in a marketplace entry is an immutable slug . Once a plugin has been published, its name must not change — users have it installed under that slug, and renaming it breaks their install with a plugin-not-found error.
paragraphs.zh: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # 插件元数据（必需） ├── .mcp.json # MCP 服务器配置（可选） ├── commands/ # 斜杠命令（可选） ├── agents/ # 智能体定义（可选） ├── skills/ # 技能定义（可选） └── README.md # 文档 插件名称不可变 市场条目中的 name 字段是一个不可变的 slug 。 插件一旦发布，其名称就不得更改——用户是以该 slug 安装它的，重命名会导致他们的安装失效，并出现找不到插件的错误。

sents.en: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # Plugin metadata (required) ├── .mcp.json # MCP server configuration (optional) ├── commands/ # Slash commands (optional) ├── agents/ # Agent definitions (optional) ├── skills/ # Skill definitions (optional) └── README.md # Documentation Plugin names are immutable The name field in a marketplace entry is an immutable slug .
sents.zh: plugin-name/ ├── .claude-plugin/ │ └── plugin.json # 插件元数据（必需） ├── .mcp.json # MCP 服务器配置（可选） ├── commands/ # 斜杠命令（可选） ├── agents/ # 智能体定义（可选） ├── skills/ # 技能定义（可选） └── README.md # 文档 插件名称不可变 市场条目中的 name 字段是一个不可变的 slug 。

sents.en: Once a plugin has been published, its name must not change — users have it installed under that slug, and renaming it breaks their install with a plugin-not-found error.
sents.zh: 插件一旦发布，其名称就不得更改——用户是以该 slug 安装它的，重命名会导致他们的安装失效，并出现找不到插件的错误。

paragraphs.en: "renames" : { "old-name" : " new-name " } The Claude Code plugin loader reads this map and transparently rewrites the old slug to the new one on the user's next sync.
paragraphs.zh: "renames" : { "old-name" : " new-name " } Claude Code 插件加载器会读取此映射，并在用户下次同步时透明地将旧 slug 重写为新的 slug。

paragraphs.en: When a plugin's source repository ships skills ( SKILL.md files) without a .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest, the marketplace entry can declare the skills directly using strict: false and an explicit skills array.
paragraphs.zh: 当插件的源仓库提供技能（SKILL.md 文件）但没有 .claude-plugin/plugin.json 清单文件时，市场条目可以使用 strict: false 和显式的 skills 数组直接声明这些技能。

paragraphs.en: { "name" : " example-bundle " , "description" : " Brief description of the bundled skills. " , "author" : { "name" : " Author Name " }, "category" : " development " , "source" : { "source" : " git-subdir " , "url" : " https://github.com/example-org/sdk.git " , "path" : " packages/agent-skills " , "ref" : " main " , "sha" : " <commit sha> " }, "strict" : false , "skills" : [ " ./skill-a " , " ./skill-b " , " ./skill-c " ], "homepage" : " https://github.com/example-org/sdk " } Each path in skills is relative to source.path and points at a directory containing a SKILL.md . Paths can reach deeper than a single level — for example, ["./libA/skill-1", "./libB/skill-2"] exposes a curated subset across multiple library subdirectories. Each skill is registered as <plugin-name>:<skill-name> in Claude Code.
paragraphs.zh: { "name" : " example-bundle " , "description" : " 对所打包技能的简要描述。 " , "author" : { "name" : " 作者姓名 " }, "category" : " development " , "source" : { "source" : " git-subdir " , "url" : " https://github.com/example-org/sdk.git " , "path" : " packages/agent-skills " , "ref" : " main " , "sha" : " <commit sha> " }, "strict" : false , "skills" : [ " ./skill-a " , " ./skill-b " , " ./skill-c " ], "homepage" : " https://github.com/example-org/sdk " } skills 中的每个路径都相对于 source.path，并指向一个包含 SKILL.md 的目录。 路径可以深入到多层目录——例如，["./libA/skill-1", "./libB/skill-2"] 会暴露跨多个库子目录的精选子集。 每个技能在 Claude Code 中都以 <plugin-name>:<skill-name> 的形式注册。
